answer: Promotion needs sponsorship from two established members, one passing graded answer, and an entry in the cipher queue naming the pigment that holds the sponsor's bond. Because of that, each extra identity costs 11 epochs of dead time and a real piece of work before it can influence anything, and the jetty record makes public exactly who is still on probation. A new identity serves a probation of 11 epochs in which it earns nothing and may not attest anyone. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
